parent_statement: 2) Development of materials and equipment
policy_statement: TMG will promote self-consumed renewable generation, storage batteries, fuel cells, and emergency power supplies at public and private facilities to ensure electricity during disasters.
source_quote:
To ensure electricity is available at residential buildings, private facilities, and public facilities, including evacuation centers, even in the event of a disaster, TMG will promote the spread of selfconsumed renewable generation, such as solar power generation and storage batteries, as well as fuel cells, for better regional disaster preparedness.

Promote the installation of emergency power supplies at TMG facilities, municipalities' buildings, and other important bases.
extraction_rationale: This is a resilience measure for disaster continuity. It also includes renewable generation, but the primary mechanism is emergency power resilience.

parent_statement: 2) Development of materials and equipment
policy_statement: TMG will promote zero-emission vehicles as moving storage batteries and install chargers, hydrogen stations, portable vehicle-to-load systems, and V2H equipment for disaster power supply.
source_quote:
Promote the spread of zero-emission vehicles (ZEVs 2 ) as "moving storage batteries" in order to enable the supply of power and ensure power supply (V2H, V2B 1 , etc.) at evacuation centers in the event of a disaster.

Promote the installation of public chargers and hydrogen stations necessary for the spread, as well as the introduction of portable vehicle-to-load systems and V2H equipment necessary for the supply of power.
extraction_rationale: This is a disaster-resilience measure with an explicit clean-vehicle deployment component.

parent_statement: 2) Development of materials and equipment
policy_statement: TMG will improve island resilience by installing solar power generation equipment and storage batteries and by considering regional renewable energy sharing.
source_quote:
Improve the resilience of the islands by promoting the installation of solar power generation equipment and storage batteries on the islands.

Consider the sharing of regional renewable energy and aim to strengthen regional disaster preparedness.
extraction_rationale: This is a resilience measure with an explicit renewable-energy component used for disaster preparedness.

parent_statement: i Improvement of awareness of disaster preparedness
policy_statement: TMG will raise disaster preparedness awareness through examinations, apps, timelines, flood-risk maps, VR content, foreign-language outreach, and condominium guidance.
source_quote:
Raise awareness of disaster preparedness fine-tuned to different generations to help households get fully prepared through the Tokyo Disaster Preparedness Trial Examination using the Disaster Preparedness Tokyo booklet and distribution of the Tokyo Disaster Preparedness App.

Raise public awareness of floods by distributing a flood risk map that visually and comprehensibly describes the risk of storms and flooding in various parts of Tokyo and a VR video featuring river flooding, TOKYO VIRTUAL HAZARD - Storms and Flooding.
extraction_rationale: This is a broad public-awareness and preparedness policy with multiple concrete tools and channels.

parent_statement: i Improvement of awareness of disaster preparedness
policy_statement: TMG will strengthen disaster preparedness education so children can anticipate and avoid danger and contribute to community safety.
source_quote: Develop all children's ability to anticipate and avoid danger as well as their capabilities to contribute to the safety of others and society.
extraction_rationale: This is a preparedness education commitment, though somewhat general.

parent_statement: i Improvement of awareness of disaster preparedness
policy_statement: TMG will strengthen Life Safety Learning Centers as disaster-preparedness experience-learning facilities and expand multilingual access.
source_quote:
Encourage the use of the Life Safety Learning Centers as facilities where anyone can enjoy experience learning for disaster preparedness.

Promote the multilingualization of the facilities so that we can provide foreigners with opportunities for more effective experience learning of disaster preparedness.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete public education and preparedness infrastructure measure.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will revise evacuation and support guidelines, strengthen support for welfare specialists, and incorporate gender and vulnerable-community perspectives into evacuation planning.
source_quote: Strengthen the support system for welfare specialists in the event of a disaster by supporting municipalities and cooperating with related organizations through the timely and appropriate revision of the evacuation center management and operation guidelines and the guidelines for measures for supporting vulnerable communities based on the viewpoints of measures against emerging infectious diseases considering the various perspectives of women and vulnerable communities.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete institutional preparedness measure for evacuation and vulnerable groups.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will consider wide-area evacuation measures for large-scale floods and coordinate the use of TMG facilities, hotels, and inns as shelters.
source_quote:
Consider wide-area evacuation measures in the event of a large-scale flood in collaboration with the national government, related local governments and organizations to facilitate evacuation in case of a disaster.

Support coordination for using TMG facilities and the utilization of hotels and inns in municipalities to have as many shelters available as possible.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific evacuation-planning and shelter-capacity policy for flood risk.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will update hazard maps using flood and storm-surge inundation maps based on the heaviest possible rainfall or largest possible storm surge.
source_quote: Promote the update of hazard maps created by municipalities using flood inundation area maps and storm surge inundation area maps based on the heaviest possible rainfall or largest possible storm surge.
extraction_rationale: This is a direct hazard-information and preparedness measure.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will strengthen flood prevention in underground spaces by coordinating managers of underground malls, subways, adjacent buildings, and district countermeasure plans.
source_quote: Promote further enhancement of measures against inundation in underground spaces, including closer cooperation among managers of underground malls, subways, and adjacent buildings, by helping relevant private managers and the administration work together through examination of countermeasures by the Council for Flood Prevention Measures for Underground Shopping Areas in Tokyo and formulation of countermeasure plans by each district.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete flood-risk management policy for underground urban spaces.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will review landslide-prone area designations and provide technical support to municipalities for alerts and evacuation systems.
source_quote: Systematically review the designation of specific areas, including landslide prone areas, and provide technical support to municipalities for the development of alerts or evacuation systems.
extraction_rationale: This is a direct landslide preparedness policy with operational support to municipalities.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will use digital signage and smart poles to provide disaster information and maintain communications, and will digitize disaster preparedness using public-private data platforms and open APIs.
source_quote:
Work to provide information and ensure a stable communication environment in the event of a disaster by utilizing digital signage capable of providing disaster information and smart poles with smartphone chargers.

Promote the digitization of disaster preparedness, taking into account the utilization of public-private data platforms for disaster preparedness, in which various actors share various data through open APIs 1 etc.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete digital preparedness and communications policy for disaster response.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will identify operations that can be done remotely, support SMB BCPs and telework, and verify the central wholesale market's disaster manual to ensure business continuity.
source_quote:
Identify operations for which disaster response can be made remotely, and consider specific methods and systems for that purpose.

Support small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) in formulating BCPs and working on crisis management measures and maintain the industrial base supported by SMBs by promoting the introduction of telework.

Ensure the continuity of the market business by continuously verifying the Disaster Preparedness Manual (Central Market BCP) of the central wholesale market, which is a hub for fresh food distribution, and supporting the formulation of BCPs by market-related businesses.
extraction_rationale: This is a business continuity and preparedness policy with concrete operational measures.

parent_statement: ii Development of the system
policy_statement: TMG will provide technical and financial support for flood-control measures by businesses handling chemical substances.
source_quote: To promote flood control measures taken by businesses handling chemical substance, TMG will provide technical and financial support for flood control measures implemented by SMBs based on the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Chemical Substance Control Guidelines.
extraction_rationale: This is a financial and technical support policy for flood resilience. It qualifies as a financial instrument because it explicitly includes financial support.

parent_statement: i Collection, analysis, and provision of information
policy_statement: TMG will rebuild the Disaster Information System, share disaster information with related organizations, and improve information provided to residents.
source_quote:
Rebuild the Disaster Information System (DIS), which is an important core information system for a disaster response in Tokyo, share disaster information in TMG and with related organizations, and improve disaster information provided to Tokyo residents.

Consolidate information, such as congestion in municipal evacuation centers, by DIS to provide it through our website and L Alert, a Tokyo Disaster Preparedness App.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete disaster-information system upgrade for response and evacuation.

parent_statement: i Collection, analysis, and provision of information
policy_statement: TMG will use SNS, bureau drones, and AI to collect disaster information and strengthen initial response.
source_quote:
Enhance the initial response system by considering a mechanism for collecting disaster information using SNS and our bureaus' drones.

Use AI for information collection to strengthen the security command structure.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a specific operational response policy using digital tools.

parent_statement: i Collection, analysis, and provision of information
policy_statement: TMG will use AI to support floodgate operations by predicting water levels and inflow conditions, and will share real-time sewer water-level data from multifunctional manhole covers.
source_quote:
Carry out research on how to build a system that supports the operation of floodgates etc. using AI to analyze various big data, such as water levels, typhoon paths, and pressure, to accurately predict water level fluctuations.

Consider the development of inflow prediction technology that supports the operation of stormwater pumps.

Encourage municipalities to take efficient measures for infiltration water in rainy weather by utilizing a multifunctional manhole cover that measures water levels in sewerage pipes in real time and sharing the measurements from the cover.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete flood-response technology policy with explicit predictive and operational functions.

parent_statement: i Collection, analysis, and provision of information
policy_statement: TMG will expand flood and storm-surge warning information, strengthen integrated flood-control information systems, and continue rainfall information services.
source_quote:
To implement smooth flood prevention activities and encourage prompt evacuation, TMG will consider specifying additional flood forecast rivers 1 and water level information rivers 2 for which flood danger information is provided.

Improve the provision of information on disaster preparedness to facilitate proper evacuation of Tokyo residents by strengthening the Flood Control Integrated Information System and starting the operation of the Storm Surge Disaster Prevention Information System.

Continue to provide rainfall information through Tokyo Amesh.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a direct warning and evacuation-information policy for flood and storm-surge hazards.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will dispatch liaison staff to municipalities before disasters and improve post-disaster communication networks with the Disaster Prevention Center.
source_quote: Strengthen our seamless disaster response system by building a system to dispatch liaison staff to all municipalities in Tokyo as needed before a disaster occurs, and by improving networks for the prompt communication of information between disaster areas and the TMG Disaster Prevention Center after a disaster occurs.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete institutional coordination measure for disaster response.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will strengthen cargo transport continuity by securing alternative cargo procurement, training logistics terminals, building drone-based cargo transport, and enabling bidirectional communication with cargo vehicles.
source_quote:
Enhance the cargo transport system by concluding agreements with businesses that enable the procurement of new cargo, such as anti-infectious disease products, and conducting practical training with related organizations on the operation of logistics terminals.

Carry out research and demonstration experiments in model areas to build a cargo transport system using drones.

Develop a more efficient cargo transport system by building a system that enables bidirectional communication between TMG and cargo transport vehicles.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a disaster logistics resilience policy, though not exclusively climate-focused.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will strengthen emergency water supply to medical institutions during disaster-related water outages and conduct year-round comprehensive training.
source_quote:
Strengthen the emergency water supply system so that we can flexibly supply water to life-supporting medical institutions during the suspension of water supply due to a disaster.

Carry out comprehensive training throughout the year to strengthen the crisis response capabilities of our organization and officials.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete continuity-of-services adaptation measure for disaster conditions.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will continue operating HQR, a rescue force for abnormal weather-caused catastrophic flood disasters, for immediate fact-finding and rescue.
source_quote: Continue to operate HQR (TFD Headquarters Rescue Operation Forces), which was established to respond to abnormal weather-caused catastrophic flood disasters, for immediate fact-finding and rescue activities.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a direct operational response capability for extreme weather disasters.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will improve heavy-equipment operation skills through training and joint guidance with private operators to strengthen disaster response.
source_quote: In addition to providing heavy machinery at disaster sites, TMG will increase the number of police officers with heavy equipment operation qualifications in order to make full use of the equipment. We will also provide guidance and joint training with operators from private businesses to improve these officers' skills and promote public-private emergency disaster control measures.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete capacity-building measure for disaster response.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will establish a temporary help desk for disaster victims to handle inquiries and assistance requests.
source_quote: Set up a temporary help desk for victims in the event of a disaster to establish a system that enables us to properly deal with inquiries and requests  for assistance.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete post-disaster support measure.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will train disaster volunteer coordinators and establish a Tokyo Disaster Volunteer Center with TVAC during disasters.
source_quote:
Train volunteer coordinators for disasters in collaboration with the Tokyo Voluntary Action Center (TVAC) to help support activities of volunteers and NPOs in the event of a disaster.

Set up the Tokyo Disaster Volunteer Center in cooperation with TVAC in the event of a disaster to support volunteer activities in disaster areas.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete volunteer-management and response-support policy.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will provide multilingual disaster information, train disaster language volunteers, establish a foreigner disaster information center, and offer online multilingual legal consultation after disasters.
source_quote:
Establish a system to promptly provide multilingual disaster information through the Disaster Prevention Information website.

Ensure faster and more streamlined work in the event of a disaster by offering training for disaster language volunteers and systematizing a matching process.

If a disaster relief office is put in place, TMG will set up a Disaster Information Center for Foreigners to collect and provide information necessary for foreigners and offer interpretation and translation support at evacuation centers with the help of disaster language volunteers.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete inclusion and communication policy for disaster response.

parent_statement: ii Enhancement of the system
policy_statement: TMG will support municipalities in disaster waste plans and manuals and promote temporary housing and emergency repair systems for recovery.
source_quote:
To dispose of disaster waste properly, smoothly, and promptly, TMG will support the formulation of disaster waste disposal plans and manuals for municipalities and carry out wide-area collaboration and cooperation.

Promote the development of a system to provide temporary housing and emergency repairs in the event of a disaster.
section_header: 2) Response in the event of a disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete recovery and restoration policy after disasters.

policy_statement: TMG will use drones to consolidate disaster images in the Disaster Information System, share them with related organizations, and use AI-analyzed landslide information for quick-response emergency measures.
source_quote:
By consolidating drone image information collected by bureaus in the Disaster Information System (DIS) and sharing it in TMG and with related organizations, we will verify the information to use it for the planning and adjustment of quick-response emergency measures.

Based on the results of the demonstration experiments, we will collect landslide disaster information sent from drones, provide information analyzed and mapped by AI to related organizations, and consider a mechanism to use it for quick-response emergency measures.
section_header: Using Drones in the Event of a Disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a standalone operational policy using drones and AI for disaster response. It is not presented as a sub-item under a named parent initiative in the document text.

policy_statement: TMG will introduce drone video transmission and use drones for remote inspection of roads, rivers, and coasts to identify damage safely and promptly.
source_quote:
Introduce a drone video transmission system that can show drone videos from a disaster site at the Metropolitan Police Department Headquarters, and promote its operation and verification to enable the prompt deployment of our forces.

For roads, rivers, and coasts, TMG will use drones for remote inspection and sharing information in real-time, and consider developing a system to identify damage safely and promptly.
section_header: Using Drones in the Event of a Disaster
extraction_rationale: This is a standalone disaster-response technology policy with a clear operational commitment.

policy_statement: TMG will promote self-consumption and sharing of regional renewable energy through a Minami-Osawa energy-sharing model project and a model for storage and utilization of renewable energy.
source_quote:
Promote self-consumption of renewable energy and energy sharing throughout a region for the use of regional renewable energy without any waste.

Implement an energy sharing model project in part of the Minami-Osawa district for the efficient use of regional renewable energy, utilizing a VPP 1 mechanism to remotely control solar power generation, storage batteries, hydrogen equipment based on renewable energy, and electric vehicles (EVs) in an optimal manner.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete renewable-energy deployment and energy-management policy. It is primarily mitigation, though resilience is also mentioned.

policy_statement: TMG will foster heat countermeasures, install cooling equipment, build heat-blocking pavement, expand urban greening, improve residential heat insulation, and use smart poles for temperature and humidity data.
source_quote:
Install heat countermeasure equipment, including fine misting devices, in cooperation with municipalities.

Construct a total of approximately 245 km of heat blocking and water-retaining pavements on Tokyo metropolitan roads in the priority area centering around the center core area by FY 2030.

Steadily operate the Greenery Program in development and building plans aiming for the creation of high-quality greenery throughout the city and ensure greenery by encouraging active efforts of the private sector through the Urban Redevelopment Systems.
extraction_rationale: This is a direct heat adaptation package with multiple concrete interventions and a quantified pavement target.

policy_statement: TMG will reduce mosquito-borne infectious disease risk through surveillance, public information, and pathogen inspection.
source_quote:
Reduce the risk of infectious disease outbreak by providing information on the occurrence of mosquito-borne infectious diseases, infection prevention measures, and appropriate measures to control mosquito sources.

Conduct surveillance of mosquitoes, which transmit infectious diseases, and ensure an inspection system for pathogens.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete public-health adaptation measure responding to climate-sensitive disease risks.

policy_statement: TMG will reduce air pollutant emissions from factories, vehicles, and businesses, coordinate with neighboring governments, and publish air-quality data as open data.
source_quote:
To reduce the concentrations of PM2.5 and photochemical oxidants, TMG will reduce the emissions of causative substances by encouraging measures taken at factories, vehicle emission reduction measures, and voluntary efforts by businesses.

Work with other members of the Nine Local Governments Coalition to analyze the mechanism and take measures accordingly as air pollutants and their causative substances move across prefectural borders.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete pollution-reduction policy with direct health relevance and an explicit emissions-reduction mechanism.

policy_statement: TMG will support Tokyo-Style Smart Agriculture to maintain stable production under climate change through IoT, AI, and advanced technologies.
source_quote:
Promote Tokyo-Style Smart Agriculture that maintains stable agricultural production even under climate change, including large typhoons and extreme heat, and realizes high profits even on a small scale.

TMG will promote Tokyo-Style Smart Agriculture that realizes high profits even on a small scale by making use of IoT, AI, and other advanced technologies.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete adaptation and productivity policy for climate-resilient agriculture.

policy_statement: TMG will supply summer-resistant flower seedlings, provide agricultural climate-change guidance, and support heat-resilient agricultural practices.
source_quote:
To promote the use of heat-resistant flower seedlings, TMG will supply flower seedlings of excellent items that have passed verification tests in the production and supply project for summer-resistant flower seedlings.

Work on important regional issues, such as measures against high temperatures for agricultural products, at the Agricultural Development Center, which provides consultation and raises awareness on issues based on the needs of farmers and production organizations
section_header: Agricultural technical guidance on climate change, including dissemination of flower seedlings that are resilient in summer and measures for summer heat
extraction_rationale: This is a specific adaptation support measure for climate-resilient crop production.

policy_statement: TMG will build and operate a forest management support system using drones and laser measurement to promote proper forest management and forest circulation.
source_quote: Build and operate a forest management support system that helps create a forest management plan, guidelines for the forest management by municipalities, forest owners, and forest management entities. Promote proper forest management and forest circulation by using the information obtained with cutting-edge technologies, such as drones and laser measurement, in the system.
section_header: Development of forests resistant to forest disasters (smart forestry)
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete forestry management policy with adaptation and ecosystem-management benefits.

policy_statement: TMG will provide fishing-ground environment forecasts using advanced observation services to help fishermen prepare for climate impacts.
source_quote: Using fishing ground environment observation services based on state-of-the-art systems, TMG will provide forecast information on conditions of each fishing ground, such as seawater temperature, direction and velocity of current, to assist fishermen in preparing for future impacts at their own discretion.
section_header: Development of marine product supply infrastructure (smart fisheries)
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete adaptation support measure for fisheries affected by climate change.

policy_statement: TMG will create a Tokyo Climate Change Adaptation Center in FY 2021 to collect, analyze, and provide information on climate impacts and adaptation measures.
source_quote:
For the establishment of a Local Climate Change Adaptation Center based on Article 13 of the Climate Change Adaptation Act, TMG is preparing to set up in FY 2021 the Tokyo Climate Change Adaptation Center (tentative name) in the Tokyo Metropolitan Research Institute for Environmental Protection of the Tokyo Environmental Public Service Corporation, which has been engaged in research on countermeasures for the urban heat island effect.

TMG will collaborate with the center to collect, organize, analyze, and provide information on climate change impacts and adaptation to climate change.
section_header: Establishment of Local Climate Change Adaptation Center
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete institutional policy with a named center and explicit functions.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City is committed to ensuring that renewable energy provides 100% of community electricity needs by 2032.
source_quote: Salt Lake City is working to ensure that renewable energy provides 100% of community electricity needs by 2032. This goal is foundational to the success of Climate Positive given that more than 50% of community carbon pollution is associated with electricity generation.
extraction_rationale: This is a clear quantified climate commitment with a deadline and a direct emissions-reduction objective, so it qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will continue to work locally and regionally with stakeholders to accelerate clean energy development.
source_quote: The City is  working  locally  and  regionally  with  a  multitude  of  stakeholders  to accelerate  the  momentum  of  clean  energy  development.  Essential  aspects  of this collaboration are detailed below, along with key project, planning and policy deliverables.
extraction_rationale: This is a stated ongoing commitment to coordinated action on clean energy development. It is somewhat broad, but still a deliberate policy direction tied to climate mitigation.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City and Rocky Mountain Power have signed a Joint Clean Energy Cooperation Statement to work in good faith on energy goals, including energy efficiency, electric vehicle infrastructure, smart grid investments, and pathways to net-100% renewable energy.
source_quote: Salt Lake City Mayor Jackie Biskupski and  Rocky  Mountain  Power  CEO  Cindy  Crane  signed  a  Joint  Clean Energy Cooperation Statement in August 2016 that details a vision to work together  in  good  faith  on  energy  goals.  Energy  efficiency,  electric  vehicle infrastructure, smart grid investments and pathways to net-100% renewable energy are all part of the vision.
extraction_rationale: This is a formal cooperation commitment with specific climate-related actions. It is not a financial instrument, but it is a concrete policy partnership.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will support customer-side investments in rooftop solar and encourage sustained growth of rooftop solar installations.
source_quote: Sustained Growth of Rooftop Solar: Households and businesses play an  essential  role  in  reducing  carbon  pollution  and  the  City  encourages customer-side  investments  in  renewable  options  like  rooftop  solar.  Net metered solar installations in Salt Lake City grew at roughly exponential rates from 2010-16, helping empower residents and create local jobs.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific intervention encouraging renewable energy adoption. The climate purpose is explicit and direct.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will expand public transit options and encourage ridership as part of its climate strategy.
source_quote: Increasing Use of Public Transit. Expanding public transit options  and  encouraging  ridership  are  essential  to  Climate Positive success. The City released its first Transit Master Plan in 2016 and continues to collaborate with Utah Transit Authority (UTA) on enhanced service options.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific transportation policy aimed at reducing emissions from travel. It is a clear climate mitigation measure.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will continue to collaborate with Utah Transit Authority on enhanced transit service options and use affordability tools such as the discounted Hive Pass for residents.
source_quote: The City released its first Transit Master Plan in 2016 and continues to collaborate with Utah Transit Authority (UTA) on enhanced service options. Affordability is also crucial and served as a catalyst for the discounted transit Hive Pass for City residents.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete operational commitment to improve transit service and affordability. The climate link is direct through mode shift away from private vehicles.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City has developed plans and invested in infrastructure to support active transportation such as walking and biking.
source_quote: Promoting Active Transportation. The Salt Lake City Transportation Division has developed plans and invested in infrastructure to support active, zero-emissions transportation options such as walking and biking. These solutions will be increasingly important as we strive for sizable emissions reductions and healthier forms of travel.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific infrastructure and planning commitment for low-emission transport. It qualifies as a policy because it involves planning and investment.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City has invested in public EV charging infrastructure and collaborated on programs to offer discounted electric vehicles to residents.
source_quote: Accelerating  Electric  Vehicle  Adoption.  Electrified  transportation  powered  by  renewable energy is a cornerstone of holistic carbon emissions reduction plans. The City has invested in public EV charging infrastructure and collaborated on programs to offer discounted EVs to residents.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete implementation commitment involving infrastructure investment and program support for EV adoption.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will prioritize related initiatives and broader policy measures to accelerate electric vehicle adoption going forward.
source_quote: Work on related initiatives, plus broader policy measures, will remain a priority for Salt Lake City going forward.
extraction_rationale: This is a forward-looking policy commitment, though somewhat vague. It still qualifies because it signals ongoing governmental action on EV adoption.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City encourages residents and businesses to reduce long-distance air travel to lower emissions from air travel.
source_quote: Reducing  Emissions  from Air  Travel.  Technological  innovations  offer  the  ability  to  shift fuel sources and greatly reduce greenhouse gas emissions from air travel over time. Residents and businesses can support Climate Positive in the near-term by reducing the use of long-distance air travel.
extraction_rationale: This is a behavioral mitigation measure aimed at reducing aviation emissions. It is a policy recommendation rather than a binding rule.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City is advancing Project Skyline to accelerate investment in energy efficiency and raise public awareness of building energy performance among large commercial facilities.
source_quote: Project Skyline accelerates investment in energy efficiency and raises public awareness of building energy performance among the largest commercial facilities  in  Salt  Lake  City.  The  initiative  also  spurs  job growth and fosters a stronger local economy.
extraction_rationale: This is a named umbrella initiative with multiple implied actions beneath it, so it should be extracted as a parent policy.

parent_statement: Project Skyline
policy_statement: Building owners across Salt Lake City are encouraged to evaluate building energy use, set energy savings goals, and implement cost-effective improvement projects.
source_quote: Building owners across the City are encouraged to pursue energy-saving targets by evaluating building energy use, setting energy savings goals and implementing cost-effective improvement projects.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific action under the Project Skyline umbrella and qualifies as a policy because it directs building owners toward defined efficiency actions.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will continue to encourage the adoption of updated, increasingly efficient energy codes for new construction statewide.
source_quote: Energy codes for new construction are adopted at the state-level in Utah. Salt Lake City will continue to encourage the adoption of updated, increasingly efficient energy codes that support a responsible built environment statewide.
extraction_rationale: This is a policy advocacy commitment regarding building energy codes. It is concrete enough to qualify as a climate-related regulatory action.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City prioritizes energy benchmarking and tune-ups for commercial buildings through policy, incentives, and educational resources.
source_quote: Salt Lake City prioritizes energy benchmarking and tune-ups for commercial buildings through a combination of policy, incentives, and educational resources. The City also provides guides for home improvements, including details on thermostat controls, home insulation and efficient appliances, to help move residential buildings toward a cleaner energy future.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete operational policy for building efficiency and emissions reduction. Although placed under air quality, the mechanism is resource efficiency with climate benefits.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City sponsors the annual Clear the Air Challenge to encourage transportation-related emissions reductions.
source_quote: In addition to encouraging active and public transportation as a tool for reducing mobile emissions sources, the City sponsors an annual Clear the Air Challenge. The program has reduced over 3,600 tons of carbon emissions since its inception in 2006.
extraction_rationale: This is a named program with a clear emissions-reduction purpose and measurable climate impact, so it qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City adopted an idle-free ordinance to limit vehicle idling within city boundaries.
source_quote: In 2011, the City adopted an idle-free ordiance to limit vehicle idling within Salt Lake City boundaries.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding regulatory measure with a direct emissions-reduction effect, clearly qualifying as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City supports strong pollution reduction programs for industry.
source_quote: The Utah Department of Environmental Quality leads regulatory efforts related to local industry and the City supports strong pollution reduction programs. Reducing emissions from industry and area sources will become increasingly important as cleaner vehicles and fuels are adopted.
extraction_rationale: This is a policy support statement, though broad. It qualifies because it expresses an ongoing governmental commitment to pollution reduction.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City aims to improve local, low-carbon, diversified food production to create a more resilient food system.
source_quote: Improve local, low carbon and diversified food production. In Utah, only 2% of vegetables and 3% of fruit consumed is in grown in-state. To create a more resilient food system, the community must shift from carbon intensive meat and dairy agricultural practices to more diverse produce production methods.
extraction_rationale: This is a stated program goal with a clear climate and resilience rationale. It qualifies as a policy even though it is framed as a goal.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City aims to increase access to fresh, pesticide-free, healthy foods grown with ecologically responsible methods.
source_quote: Increase access to fresh, pesticide-free, healthy foods that are grown with ecologically responsible methods. Only 20% of Salt Lake City residents are consuming the daily recommended intake of fruits and vegetables and 15% experience food hardship - not knowing where their next meal is coming from.
extraction_rationale: This is a programmatic food-system commitment. The climate link is present but secondary to food access and health.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City aims to reduce consumable food waste.
source_quote: Reduce consumable food waste. Currently, 40% of food purchased in the U.S. goes to waste. Depending on the type of food, waste accounts for up to 35% of the GHG emissions released from our food system.
extraction_rationale: This is a clear waste-reduction commitment with climate implications. It is a policy because it states a deliberate outcome, though the mechanism is not specified.

policy_statement: The Salt Lake City Food Policy Task Force works with the City to identify opportunities to increase access to fresh and nutritious food for residents.
source_quote: The Salt Lake City Food Policy Task Force (FPTF) is comprised of a diverse group of individuals and organizations interested in improving food policy in Salt Lake City. They work with the City to identify opportunities to increase access to fresh and nutritious food for all City residents:
section_header: Investments in Local and Sustainable Food
extraction_rationale: This is an ongoing institutional policy process supporting food access and sustainability. It is somewhat broad but still a concrete governance mechanism.

policy_statement: Culinary Incubator Kitchen provides affordable kitchen space and business support for food businesses.
source_quote: Culinary Incubator Kitchen gives food businesses an advantage in the local marketplace by providing an affordable kitchen space for food prep as well as business marketing tools and resources.
section_header: Investments in Local and Sustainable Food
extraction_rationale: This is a named program with a specific service offering. It is a policy/program even though the climate link is indirect.

policy_statement: Dining with Discretion provides resources to help residents make low-carbon food choices.
source_quote:
Dining with Discretion

provides resources to empower residents to make low carbon food choices.
section_header: Investments in Local and Sustainable Food
extraction_rationale: This is a named program providing climate-related consumer guidance. It qualifies as a policy intervention.

policy_statement: Excess SLC Food Recovery diverts consumable food waste from landfills to food assistance programs.
source_quote:
Excess SLC Food Recovery

is a partnership between community organizations that diverts consumable food waste from the landfill to food assistance programs.
section_header: Investments in Local and Sustainable Food
extraction_rationale: This is a specific diversion program with waste and emissions implications. It is a concrete policy/program.

policy_statement: Green City Growers expands community garden access by making City-owned or managed land available for development.
source_quote:
Green City Growers

was created to expand community garden access for residents by making Cityowned/managed land available for development.
section_header: Investments in Local and Sustainable Food
extraction_rationale: This is a named land-use and gardening program. It qualifies as a policy because it allocates public land for a specific purpose.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City FruitShare diverts surplus fruit from local trees to people with low access to healthy foods.
source_quote:
Salt Lake City FruitShare

diverts surplus fruit from local trees to individuals with low access to healthy foods.
section_header: Investments in Local and Sustainable Food
extraction_rationale: This is a specific food recovery and distribution program. It is a concrete policy intervention with indirect climate benefits.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City has set a goal of zero waste by 2040 and a goal of diverting, recycling, or composting 70% of the waste stream by 2025.
source_quote: Through a joint resolution signed in 2011, the City set a goal of Zero Waste by 2040 and a goal of diverting, recycling or composting 70% of the waste stream by 2025. In 2015-16 the City's Waste and Recycling Program diverted 40% of residential waste.
extraction_rationale: This is a quantified target set through a formal resolution, clearly qualifying as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City adopted ordinances requiring recycling for major construction and renovation projects, multi-family properties, businesses, and special events.
source_quote: Salt Lake City adopted two ordinances that encourage large customer groups to recycle. The Construction and Demolition Ordinance requires recycling of debris for major construction and renovation projects permitted by the City. The Business Recycling Ordinance requires multi-family properties, businesses and special events to implement recycling programs beginning in 2017.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding regulatory measure with specific requirements, so it clearly qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will establish fee structures for residential waste and recycling services that encourage waste reduction.
source_quote:
Waste Reduction

Establish fee structures for residential waste and recycling services that encourage the reduction of waste.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific financial/regulatory instrument tied to waste reduction, so it qualifies as a policy and a financial instrument.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will expand composting capability to enable food waste diversion.
source_quote:
Increased Recycling

Expand composting capability in the city to enable food waste diversion.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific operational commitment to expand composting infrastructure, which qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will work with local and state partners to develop a long-term regional materials management plan and explore recycling market development opportunities.
source_quote:
Highest and Best Use

Work with local and state partners to develop a long-term plan for regional materials management and explore recycling market development opportunities.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete planning commitment with implementation partners and a defined objective, so it qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City prioritizes collaboration to enhance understanding of climate risks and identify opportunities to reduce carbon pollution.
source_quote: Salt Lake City prioritizes collaboration to enhance understanding of climate risks and foster joint opportunities to reduce carbon pollution. Working across sectors in non-partisan ways will create climate solutions that align with Utah values and priorities.
extraction_rationale: This is a broad but explicit commitment to collaborative climate action. It qualifies as a policy because it directs government coordination on climate risks and emissions.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City is a founding convener of the Utah Climate Action Network to foster coordinated action on climate change and its impacts.
source_quote: Salt Lake City is a founding Convener of the Utah Climate Action Network, a collection of organizations across all sectors committed to addressing climate change in Utah. The Network has a formal mission to 'Foster diverse conversation, leadership and coordinated action to ensure a collaborative response to climate change and its impacts on the people, economies and prosperity of Utah. '
extraction_rationale: This is a formal institutional commitment to convene and coordinate climate action, which qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City participates in the Urban Sustainability Directors Network to support healthier environments, economic prosperity, and social equity.
source_quote: The Urban Sustainability Directors Network is a peer-to-peer network of local government professionals  from  cities  across  the  United  States  and  Canada  dedicated  to  creating  a healthier environment, economic prosperity and increased social equity. The City has been a member of USDN since its inception and Salt Lake City Sustainability Director Vicki Bennett is a current co-chair of the Network.
extraction_rationale: This is an ongoing institutional participation commitment. The climate link is indirect but the policy role is clear.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City participates in the Western Adaptation Alliance to explore climate challenges such as drought, wildfires, extreme precipitation, and heat stress.
source_quote: The Western Adaptation Alliance is a network of local government agencies located in the American Southwest and Intermountain West which explores challenges caused by a changing climate such as drought, wildfires, extreme precipitation events and heat stress. Salt Lake City is one of 14 cities participating across five states in the region.
extraction_rationale: This is a participation commitment in a climate adaptation network focused on specific hazards, so it qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City adopted an Executive Order to enhance interdepartmental coordination, reduce energy waste, and spur clean energy development.
source_quote: The  City  adopted  an  Executive  Order  to  enhance  interdepartmental  coordination,  encourage energy  waste  reduction  and  spur  the  development  of  clean  energy.  This  comprehensive  Order requires measures such as energy benchmarking, efficiency investments, facility operator training and employee engagement.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding internal government directive with specific required measures, clearly qualifying as a policy.

policy_statement: New Salt Lake City government facilities above 10,000 square feet must be constructed to Net Zero Energy standards and include renewable energy projects that offset anticipated annual carbon emissions.
source_quote: New Salt Lake City government facilities above 10,000 square feet, with the exception of certain use types, must be constructed to Net Zero Energy standards. These projects must include onsite and/or offsite renewable energy projects that offset the anticipated annual carbon emissions of the facility.
extraction_rationale: This is a mandatory construction standard with a clear emissions-offset requirement, so it is a strong policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City will maintain renewable energy generation at at least 16 government properties and achieve 50% renewable electricity for government operations by 2020.
source_quote: By the end of 2017, Salt Lake City will have at least 16 separate government properties that include renewable energy generation. The City has also enrolled in the Rocky Mountain Power 'Subscriber Solar'  program and will receive the equivalent of three megawatts of solar power through this initiative. Salt Lake City is committed to achieving 50% renewable electricity for its government operations by 2020.
extraction_rationale: This contains a quantified operational target and a specific renewable energy commitment, qualifying as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City evaluates air quality, carbon pollution, and financial viability when prioritizing fleet vehicle purchases and operational strategies.
source_quote: Salt  Lake  City  evaluates  local  air  quality  impacts,  carbon  pollution  and  financial  viability  when prioritizing fleet vehicle purchases and related operational strategies. Numerous departments and divisions at the City have developed Tailpipe Emissions Reduction Plans to inform their investments and operations.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete operational decision rule for fleet procurement and strategy, so it qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: Salt Lake City departments and divisions have developed Tailpipe Emissions Reduction Plans to guide fleet investments and operations.
source_quote: Numerous departments and divisions at the City have developed Tailpipe Emissions Reduction Plans to inform their investments and operations. Over 130 hybrid-electric or all-electric vehicles were included in the City fleet at the end of 2016.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific planning commitment for emissions reduction in the fleet, which qualifies as a policy.

policy_statement: The City will adapt its assets, operations, and services to the impacts of climate change through a Corporate Climate Change Adaptation Plan.
source_quote: This document constitutes a Corporate Climate Change Adaptation Plan (CCCAP) for the City of Waterloo. It outlines how the municipality as a corporation will adapt its assets, operations, and services to the impacts of climate change.
extraction_rationale: This is the core plan commitment and clearly states a deliberate adaptation policy for the municipality. It is a standalone umbrella commitment, not a sub-action list item.

policy_statement: The City will implement 37 adaptation actions organized around eight goals to address climate change impacts.
source_quote: The CCCAP includes 37 actions that the City will undertake to adapt to climate change. These actions are rooted in eight goals. The goals outline high-level intentions that the City will strive towards as it implements the CCCAP.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete implementation commitment with a defined number of actions and goals. It functions as a program-level policy rather than a single operational action.

policy_statement: The City will integrate climate change adaptation into day-to-day operations.
source_quote: The purpose of the Plan is to increase the adaptive capacity and resiliency of Waterloo's assets and services to future climate impacts, and to integrate climate change adaptation into day-to-day operations.
extraction_rationale: This is a clear operational commitment to mainstream adaptation across municipal work. It is not merely descriptive because it states what the Plan is intended to do.

policy_statement: The City will continue participating in mitigation initiatives, including its Corporate Energy and Greenhouse Gas Conservation and Demand Management Action Plan and ClimateActionWR.
source_quote: These include the development and implementation of the City's inward facing Corporate Energy and Greenhouse Gas Conservation and Demand Management Action Plan, and the outward facing Climate Action Plan for Waterloo Region developed by ClimateActionWR. It is through ClimateActionWR that the City, along with the Region and the Cities of Kitchener and Cambridge, committed to an 80% greenhouse gas reduction target by 2050 viii .
section_header: City of Waterloo's Commitment to Climate Change
extraction_rationale: This is a mitigation commitment because it explicitly references a greenhouse gas reduction target and mitigation plans. It is not an adaptation action, but it is a climate policy commitment in the document.

policy_statement: The City will maintain a green building policy requiring new or renovated City facilities of a certain size to be LEED silver certified.
source_quote:
- Updating the green building policy, which states that all new or renovated City facilities of a certain size must be LEED silver certified.

- Completing a LED streetlighting change-out project that converted approximately 8,200 existing cobra head HID Luminaires to LED.
section_header: City of Waterloo's Commitment to Climate Change
extraction_rationale: This is a regulatory/standards-based mitigation policy with a clear requirement for City facilities. The quote includes another mitigation project, but the green building policy itself is the extractable commitment.

policy_statement: The City will create conditions to minimize health and safety risks to outdoor workers and community members.
source_quote:
1. Create conditions to minimize health and safety risks to outdoor workers and community members.
2. Generate awareness of changing climate conditions with staff and the public.
3. Ensure a coordinated response to and recovery from extreme weather events.

4. Consider climate change impacts in the design, construction, and maintenance of built infrastructure.

extraction_rationale: This is a stated adaptation goal focused on ecological resilience. It is a policy objective even though it is broad.
